exposure: fasting plasma glucose (FPG) early in pregnancy (eGDM)
outcome: History of previous gestational diabetes mellitus
Abnormal puerperal oral glucose tolerance test
cohort: 1891 women with gestational diabetes mellitus (1004 with early GDM and 887 with late GDM)
finding: Women with early gestational diabetes mellitus had higher pre-pregnancy BMI, more frequent family history of diabetes mellitus, more frequent history of previous gestational diabetes mellitus, were more likely to have chronic hypertension, and were more likely to deliver by cesarean section and to present an abnormal puerperal oral glucose tolerance test, but there was no difference in neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with early GDM were more likely to deliver by cesarean section.
